Name: New Harvey Beach Portraits and Sprites
Author: mayfieldsss
Description: In order to install this mod, you must first download the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. Once you have installed that mod, put it into your mod folder and download this one. Open the Seasonal Cute Characters folder and go into the portraits folder. Open Harvey's folder and insert the Harvey portrait from this mod inside there. When your computer asks to replace the image, click yes. After that, click the character folder, open Harvey's folder and insert my Harvey sprite sheet, if it asks to replace it, click yes. the nose and mustache arent included in my sprites and portraits because they are already included in the original mod. Once you go inside the folders, you'll see that. The images should show up normally in game.

Downloads.Description: Includes the edited Portraits and Sprites. Enjoy.
